verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law firm that says it uses legal tech, digital workflows, AI-based systems and a software-supported ySolutions unit. Asking whether clients can control retention and deletion of their data is therefore a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack, however, documents no retention settings, deletion controls or data-handling policy for client data. Its IP/IT/Data Protection practice is legal advice to other companies, not a capability of its own service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
